definitions: To strike something or someone with a blow or missile.
To come into contact with something.
To reach a particular level or amount.
To affect someone or something adversely.
To arrive at a place or time.
examples: He tried to hit the ball.
The car is about to hit the wall.
The company aims to hit its sales target.
The news is going to hit them hard.
We expect to hit the city by noon.
